title: [Indie Dev] I made King Hero Saga — a fantasy RPG with castle defense, hero upgrades, and monster waves. You can play it in your browser!
author: Background_Cheek5251
selftext:
Hey everyone! 👋

I'm an indie developer working on **King Hero Saga**, a fantasy RPG that combines castle defense, hero progression, and equipment crafting.

After a lot of development, I'm excited to finally share a playable browser version!

⚔️ **What can you do in the game?**

* Defend your castle against waves of monsters.
* Collect heroes and upgrade their skills.
* Craft weapons and armor at the Blacksmith.
* Upgrade equipment and strengthen your team.
* Progress through campaign stages.
* Summon new heroes to expand your collection.

The game is designed for portrait gameplay, so you can enjoy it on mobile or play directly in your desktop browser.

🎮 **Play King Hero Saga here:**

[https://playgama.ai/play/kfj5z2qyvk4cqw](https://playgama.ai/play/kfj5z2qyvk4cqw)

I'm continuing to improve the game, and I'd really appreciate your feedback!

In particular, I'd love to know:

* Is the combat fun and engaging?
* Does the tutorial explain the mechanics clearly?
* What do you think of the art style and character progression?

If you give it a try, let me know what you think — especially if you encounter bugs or anything confusing.

Thanks for checking out my game! ❤️
